contract: Diagnostic quiz and repeated-use admin workspace. Preserve existing layout and dark mode. Light surfaces: neutral canvas, white panels, cobalt primary actions; green success, amber pending, red errors. Check 1440x900 desktop and 390x844 mobile. Local seed fixtures only; no backend writes.
